estimand.conditioning_context: phi_i(Z_<k) is the tuple of nearest aligned parent-level categorical code(s) at the coordinate's dyadic ancestor locations, plus a deterministic coarse summary bin computed only from those parent codes. Context definition and binning are fixed per law; no held-out outcomes enter context construction.
estimand.independent_model: q_ind(z_i|phi_i), categorical table fit on fit split with symmetric Dirichlet alpha=0.5 per outcome category
estimand.tree_model: Maximum spanning tree selected on fit split using conditional pairwise mutual information pooled within phi strata; each node table conditions on phi and its selected parent code, with symmetric Dirichlet alpha=0.5 per outcome category. Root conditions on phi only.
estimand.causal_ar_model: q_AR(z_i|phi_i,z_{i-1},z_{i-2}), categorical table with the same Dirichlet smoothing; order is fixed at two and only preceding within-level coordinates are used.
estimand.held_out_estimand: Mean per-sequence summed log-loss difference DeltaH_tree = Hhat_eval(q_ind)-Hhat_eval(q_tree); bootstrap resamples whole independent sequences, 2000 replicates, percentile 95% interval.
estimand.finite_sample_claim: Conditional on a fitted q independent of the evaluation sample, the evaluation mean cross-entropy is an unbiased estimate of H(P,q)=H(P)+KL(P||q), hence of an upper bound on the true conditional entropy. DeltaH_tree is an out-of-sample predictive gain of the selected pairwise tree over the independent-coordinate model; it is not an unbiased estimate or finite-sample lower bound on true total correlation.

parity.interpretation: Pairwise trees cannot capture pure three-way parity; AR is a diagnostic comparison, not a universal TC oracle.

stage_b_kill_criterion.alternative_threshold: fine-level estimated predictive dependence gain greater than the sum of measured coarse-level marginal-rate reductions
stage_b_kill_criterion.decision: If either threshold is exceeded by the lower endpoint of the 95% sequence-bootstrap interval, pure level-parallel K=3 is rejected for this codec/data regime.

prohibitions: No real-text files, splits, or checkpoints may be opened in Stage A.
A failed calibration gate terminates the audit; no Stage B estimate is permitted.
